local.scope: Literal forward and inverse-transpose replay on every arbitrary data/helper column, physical frame incidence, ordered paid wrappers, cleared private work and prefix coefficients. Global hosting and outer exponent are separate.

native.scope: Fresh exact forward and inverse-transpose scalar replay on every arbitrary input; all native frame chains and dyadic primitives. Phase lowering, wrappers, global owners and global assembly are separate.

phase.scope: Only previously unseen ordered pairs of actual canonical subspaces were freshly lowered. Identical baseline pairs and all endpoint adapters reuse the pinned phase certificates; no full cold replay was performed.
phase.vector_arithmetic: Exact checked int64 Gaussian dyadics; cached permutations and Z4 phase actions. No floating-point equality.
